_comment: Audited 2026-10-12: each employer proves >=4 of the operator's 8 terms on its own public pages, quote + URL per term, fetched that day. Term numbers: 1 fully remote, 2 no on-call, 3 no quota, 4 pay published, 5 time-off minimum, 6 async, 7 work from anywhere, 8 health covered. Used by config/companies.json category terms_proven. Re-audit before trusting after ~6 months.

1.quote: The most transparent company, ever We're open-source and fully remote.

4.quote: We have a set system for compensation as part of being transparent. You can use our compensation calculator below to see what your compensation might look like when you're joining PostHog

5.quote: We offer our team unlimited time off, but with an expectation that you take at least 25 days off a year , including national holidays. ... The 25 days is a minimum, not a guide.

6.quote: We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days

8.quote: PostHog pays 100% of the premium of the Platinum plan for team members, and 75% for dependents.

red_flags: Some roles include on-call: Product Engineer posting says 'This role will also include some on-call time' (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/posthog/20ab9628-20ff-4ae3-bd6a-46ae7e9dc6b8); SRE posting includes on-call.
AI Research Engineer posting is 'a hybrid-remote position based out of our London office' (role-specific).
Sales roles carry quota/OTE (time-off page references 'quota-carrying Sales roles').

1.quote: GitLab is one of the world's largest all-remote companies A world leader in remote work Learn how we've scaled as an asynchronous, no-office company

4.quote: The base salary range for this role's listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.

5.quote: We strongly recommend taking at least two consecutive weeks of time off and at minimum 25 days total throughout the year.

6.quote: We collaborate asynchronously across regions and partner with marketing, sales development, and technical teams.

red_flags: Publicly traded, large company; handbook lists on-call rotations (e.g., 'SSCS Tier 2 On-Call Rotation', 'GitLab Support On-Call Guide') for some teams.
PTO requires 'at least twice as many days of advance notice as the duration of your planned absence' (time-away-philosophy page).
Compensation-calculator and global-mobility handbook pages returned HTTP 403 today, so not used.
